lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 863 Complaint No. 05-0157-955 File Number

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What time do they give you lunch usually up there, Brendan?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Oh, I'm sure they saved ya right? I imagine.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: .......... with your mom too. OK? Tell her exactly what you told us.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So that she can quit blaming us for everything, all right?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Cuz, once she sees the tape, she's gonna know anyway.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And just like I told ya with your attorneys that's, that's the only way she can help you too, is if she knows the truth and that she knows what type of help ta try and get you.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: At first my mom was really pissed off at my attorney.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz, like four weeks ago I called him and left a, an, um answering machine, a message on his answering machine but he never did what I told him to cuz I was giving him permission ta talk to my mom about what he's gonna be doing and that.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. Is that better? I mean the attorney talks to ya now doesn't he and stuff?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He talks ta me but he don't talk ta my mom.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Have you told him that he can tell your mom stuff.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Not, I just left that message on his answering machine.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. If you want your mom to know, your gonna have ta tell him that.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Tell him directly, don't leave messages. OK?
